long_biography.plain_text:
Kragset, born in 1960, comes from Hakallestranda on Norway's west coast. His working life at sea began aboard coastal carriers and cruise ships during the 1980s. He became a state pilot in Stavanger, guiding vessels through Norwegian waters while developing plans for his own passenger operations.

Kragset purchased a former Oslo-Nesodden ferry at a forced sale and repurposed it for fjord cruises, events, worker transport and a floating fashion shop linked to his family's retail business. Through Fjordkongen AS he subsequently expanded into luxury chartering, personally captaining a classic vessel and tailoring itineraries around Western Norway. The company remains under the joint beneficial ownership of Kragset and his wife through a jointly owned holding company.
